requirements.quote:
3.3.10. NULL RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                  <anything>                   /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

Anything at all may be in the RDATA field so long as it is 65535 octets
or less.
requirements.condition: When using the experimental NULL RR with RDATA of at most 65535 octets.
requirements.required_behavior: The RDATA field may contain arbitrary data.
requirements.why_checkable: NULL RDATA encoding and decoding can be checked for support of arbitrary octet contents within the permitted length, without imposing a content format.

requirements.quote:
3.3.10. NULL RDATA format (EXPERIMENTAL)

    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+
    /                  <anything>                   /
    /                                               /
    +--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+--+

Anything at all may be in the RDATA field so long as it is 65535 octets
or less.
requirements.condition: When encoding the RDATA field of the experimental NULL RR.
requirements.required_behavior: Limit RDATA to at most 65535 octets.
requirements.why_checkable: The encoded NULL RDATA length can be measured and compared with the explicit 65535-octet upper bound.

requirements.quote: NULL records cause no additional section processing.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Initiate additional section processing as a consequence of the NULL record.
requirements.why_checkable: Record-type dispatch and response construction can be inspected to determine whether NULL records trigger additional section processing.

requirements.quote:
NULL RRs are not
allowed in master files.
requirements.condition: When representing records in a master file.
requirements.forbidden_behavior: Include NULL RRs in a master file.
requirements.why_checkable: Master-file record handling can be checked to ensure NULL RRs are not treated as permitted master-file entries; no particular error response is specified.
